| State | Matched | State | Matched |
|-------|---------|-------|---------|
| 0 | (none) | 2 | "19" |
| 1 | "1" | 3 | "196" |
| | | 4 | "1966" (absorbing) |

Let Eᵢ = expected additional digits to reach state 4 from state i. E₄ = 0.
